facts.fact: Nigeria's communications ministry says the Federal Executive Council approved NUCA and NAIT in 2025, institutionalising nationwide connectivity expansion and AI governance.
Nigeria's communications ministry says the formal launch of Nigeria's National AI Strategy took place in 2025.
Nigeria's communications ministry says N-ATLAS, described as Africa's first government-backed multimodal and multilingual LLM, was launched in 2025.

NGA.note: No civil service digital-skills training stated.

facts.fact: Nigeria's communications ministry says the Federal Executive Council approved 4,000 telecom towers in 2025 to expand rural connectivity.
Nigeria's communications ministry says it received a N1 billion Airtel Africa Foundation grant to 3MTT and hosted the 3MTT National Impact Summit in 2025, with no number trained stated.

NGA.note: Project BRIDGE is in planning and stakeholder alignment only; no contract or works stated.
Only a submarine cable resilience summit is stated; no route.
The e-Governance Bill's content on data sharing between public bodies is not stated.
No government staff running or building systems stated.
The grant to 3MTT and the EU package go to a programme and the government, not a private digital business.

facts.fact: Nigeria's communications ministry says the National Digital Economy & e-Governance Bill (2025) was advanced through public hearings.
